messages:
olivia: quick RFC follow-up: propose decoupling soft-eviction timing from pin lifetime using an explicit eviction_grace token. makes fairness reasoning simpler and avoids pins implicitly extending eviction windows across tenants.

sam: what's the minimal API change? header on AcquirePin/ReleasePin?

olivia: yes: optional field eviction_grace_id on AcquirePin/ReleasePin. runtime keeps tiny grace record keyed by id. pins still protect immediately; grace controls soft->hard demote delay. example: AcquirePin(prefix, pin_id, eviction_grace_id="gr-7").

mike: can grace outlive pins? risk of stale tokens. need GC.

olivia: intended to outlive pins sometimes. GC via TTL + safety margin; refresh on any use. expose telemetry for active_grace_count and GC_lag.

aina: handoff: how does new owner learn active grace ids? add to handoff RPC or central service?

olivia: prefer piggybacking grace state in handoff RPC short-term, plus a small reconcile endpoint for rare misses.

sam: piggyback is simple but hybrid solves cross-cluster edge cases.

mike: invariants: 1) pins block eviction always, 2) grace only delays hard demote, never overrides pins, 3) handoff idempotent.

olivia: eviction controller enforces pin_count==0 && grace_expired before hard demote.

jean: concurrency: concurrent refreshes and clock skew can misgc. add epoch/version on grace records.

olivia: grace record = id, epoch, last_refresh_ts, origin_node. refresh bumps epoch; write monotonic counter to handoff log; handoff transfers epoch.

aina: telemetry/alerts to add: active_grace_count, mean_grace_duration, grace_gc_delay, handoff_grace_misses, evict_blocked_by_grace.

olivia: rollout: opt-in flag enable_eviction_grace per node; start dev cluster canary.

sam: SDK compat: optional field, default empty; no breaking change.

mike: perf/storage: cheap extra check on eviction path. soft cap grace records per-shard + LRU if needed.

olivia: open q's: TTL (suggest 30s), safety margin (10s), cross-cluster transfer start single-cluster, admin override API to expire grace.

jean: +1 on admin override and debug endpoint listing grace ids for a prefix.

aina: I'll draft a short follow-up RFC with API snippets, canary checklist, and telemetry dashboards.

olivia: I'll open RFC PR and tag infra.

infra-bot: created INFRA-1098 for canary resources (assigned to eng-runtime on-call).

sam: reminder: keep ReleasePin semantics unchanged when grace present.

olivia: yep, backward-compatible. document behavior in /docs/runtime/eviction.md.

mike: :thumbsup: monitor week-1 metrics; roll back if grace GC or handoff misses spike.
